key_findings: Daidzein reduced paclitaxel-induced pain hypersensitivity, downregulating TRPV1/P2Y and upregulating Nrf2/HO-1.
Daidzein reduced neuronal apoptosis, DNA damage and pro-inflammatory mediators.
